Audio.label: Volume steps
Audio.help: Select the size of the volume step when the VOLUME buttons are pressed.

Audio.label: Long press volume steps
Audio.help: Select the size of the volume steps when the VOLUME buttons are held down.

Audio.label: Volume/Mute display timer
Audio.help: Select how long, in seconds, that the volume and mute displays are shown before they automatically hide.

Audio.label: PCM Multichannel
Audio.help: Select whether multichannel audio tracks should be output as PCM.

Audio.label: AC3 downmix
Audio.help: Select whether AC3 audio tracks should be downmixed to stereo.

Audio.label: Passthrough audio handling delay AC3
Audio.help: Used to specify delay when switching between services and AC3 passthrough is enabled.

Audio.label: Passthrough audio handling delay AC3+
Audio.help: Used to specify delay when switching between services and AC3+/Atmos passthrough is enabled.

Audio.label: AC3 plus transcoding
Audio.help: Select whether AC3 Plus audio tracks should be transcoded to AC3.

Audio.label: AC4
Audio.help: Select whether AC4 (Dolby Atmos) audio tracks should be passed through to the AVR, downmixed to stereo, or auto-routed based on HDMI sink capability.

Audio.label: DTS downmix
Audio.help: Select whether DTS channel audio tracks should be downmixed to stereo.

Audio.label: DTS/DTS-HD HR/DTS-HD MA/DTS:X
Audio.help: Select whether DTS channel audio tracks should be downmixed or transcoded.

Audio.label: Dolby TrueHD
Audio.help: Select whether Dolby TrueHD audio tracks should be passed through or decoded.

Audio.label: WMA Pro
Audio.help: Select whether WMA Pro channel audio tracks should be downmixed or transcoded.

Audio.label: AAC downmix
Audio.help: Select whether multichannel audio tracks should be downmixed to stereo.

Audio.label: AAC plus downmix
Audio.help: Select whether multichannel audio tracks should be downmixed to stereo.

Audio.label: AAC transcoding
Audio.help: Select whether AAC audio tracks should be transcoded.

Audio.label: Audio Source
Audio.help: Select whether multichannel audio tracks should be converted to PCM or SPDIF.

Audio.label: General AC3 delay
Audio.help: This option selects the general audio delay of Dolby Digital sound tracks.

Audio.label: General PCM delay
Audio.help: This option selects the general audio delay of stereo sound tracks.

Audio.label: 3D Surround
Audio.help: This option allows you to enable 3D Surround Sound.

Audio.label: 3D Surround Speaker Position
Audio.help: This option allows you to change the virtual loudspeaker position.

Audio.label: Audio Auto Volume Level
Audio.help: This option allows you to set the Auto Volume Level output.

Audio.label: Enable BT audio
Audio.help: This option allows you to switch Audio to Bluetooth speakers.

Audio.label: General BT audio delay
Audio.help: This option configures the audio delay value for Bluetooth speakers.

HDMICEC.label: Enabled
HDMICEC.help: Enable or disable using HDMI-CEC.

HDMICEC.label: Advanced Settings
HDMICEC.help: Enable the advanced HDMI-CEC setting options.

HDMICEC.label: Regard Deep Standby as Standby
HDMICEC.help: Set to 'Yes' to enable sending the same TV commands for Deep Standby as for regular Standby.

HDMICEC.label: Wait for timesync at startup
HDMICEC.help: If the Deep Standby workaround is enabled wait until the system time is synchronized. Depending on the requirement the device wake up will continuing after a maximum of 2 minutes.

HDMICEC.label: Put TV in Standby
HDMICEC.help: Automatically put the TV in Standby whenever the receiver goes into Standby or Deep Standby.

HDMICEC.label: Even if TV has another input active?
HDMICEC.help: You can skip this function and turn off the TV when you wake the receiver from Standby and immediately switch back to Standby.

HDMICEC.label: Wake up TV from Standby
HDMICEC.help: When the receiver wakes from Standby or Deep Standby it will send a command to the TV to bring it out of Standby.

HDMICEC.label: Even if a 'Zap' recording timer starting?
HDMICEC.help: Select 'Yes' if you want to wake the TV for a 'Zap' recording timer is starting.

HDMICEC.label: Even if a 'Zap and Record' recording timer starting?
HDMICEC.help: Select 'Yes' if you want to wake the TV for a 'Zap and Record' recording timer is starting.

HDMICEC.label: Even if a 'Wakeup' scheduled task starting?
HDMICEC.help: Select 'Yes' if you want to wake the TV when a 'Wakeup' scheduled task is starting.

HDMICEC.label: Switch TV to correct input
HDMICEC.help: When the receiver wakes from Standby, send active source, stream path and routing commands so the TV switches to the HDMI input connected to the receiver.

HDMICEC.label: Switch off the TV to correct input
HDMICEC.help: Some TVs can't switch to the correct input if another HDMI port is active. This setting puts the TV into Standby before switching. If the TV does not turn back on, a slower transmission interval or repeating the wake-up command may be required.

HDMICEC.label: Handle wake up from TV
HDMICEC.help: When enabled, the receiver will automatically wake from Standby when the TV is turned on.

HDMICEC.label: Handle Standby from TV
HDMICEC.help: When enabled, the receiver will automatically return to Standby when the TV is turned off.

HDMICEC.label: Process action from TV
HDMICEC.help: Select the receiver action when the TV switches away from the receiver input.

HDMICEC.label: Time delay until Standby or Deep Standby
HDMICEC.help: 'Handle Standby from TV' has a higher priority than 'Handle input from TV'.

HDMICEC.label: Use TV remote control
HDMICEC.help: Allows the TV remote to be used to control the receiver.

HDMICEC.label: Forward volume keys
HDMICEC.help: Volume keys on the receiver remote will control the TV, AV receiver or soundbar volume over HDMI-CEC. If this feature is not supported the volume keys have no function!

HDMICEC.label: Put your AV Receiver or Soundbar in Standby
HDMICEC.help: When enabled, the connected AV receiver or soundbar will automatically be switched off.

HDMICEC.label: Wake up your AV Receiver or Soundbar from Standby
HDMICEC.help: When enabled, the connected AV receiver or soundbar will automatically be switched on.

HDMICEC.label: Minimum send interval
HDMICEC.help: Optional delay between CEC commands when sending a series of commands. Leave disabled unless a device requires slower transmission.

HDMICEC.label: Repeat the sent standby and wake up commands
HDMICEC.help: Try to send repeated commands if not all commands were executed (e.g. TV wake up, but not switched to correct input).

HDMICEC.label: Time delay for the repeated transmission
HDMICEC.help: The time is multiplied by the current repeat counter.

HDMICEC.label: Repeat the standby commands
HDMICEC.help: The command to wake from Standby will be sent multiple times.

HDMICEC.label: Check power and input state from TV
HDMICEC.help: An attempt is made to capture the current TV status. If status messages are incorrect or missing, the receiver may respond unexpectedly. Otherwise, it helps the receiver handle different operating conditions more effectively.

HDMICEC.label: Ignore unexpectedly wake up and stay in Standby
HDMICEC.help: This is a workaround for devices that wake up immediately after entering Standby. Wake-up commands from other devices are ignored for a few seconds.

HDMICEC.label: Use HDMI-preemphasis
HDMICEC.help: This setting can help improve signal quality or prevent issues with longer HDMI cables.

HDMICEC.label: Enable command line function
HDMICEC.help: Activate a way to send individual or specific internal HDMI-CEC commands from the command line.

HDMICEC.label: Enable debug log
HDMICEC.help: If enabled, a log will be kept of CEC protocol traffic. The log files are located with the other log files but named 'Enigma2-hdmicec-[date].log'.

VolumeAdjust.label: Volume adjustment mode
VolumeAdjust.help: Select 'Disabled' to disable all automated volume adjustments. Select 'Defined volume offsets' to assign a specified offset to the service's volume level. Select 'Last used/set volume' to remember the volume level last used for each service.

VolumeAdjust.label: Default volume offset
VolumeAdjust.help: This is the initial / default volume offset applied to any services added to the volume adjust list.

VolumeAdjust.label: Default Dolby Digital / Dolby AC-3 offset
VolumeAdjust.help: This offset will only be used if the channel does not have its own volume offset.

VolumeAdjust.label: Auto show volume level
VolumeAdjust.help: Select 'Yes' to show the volume level on any automated changes of volume level.

AutoLanguage.label: Audio language selection 1
AutoLanguage.help: Configure the first audio language (highest priority).

AutoLanguage.label: Prefer AC3 track
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, the receiver will select an AC3 track (when available).

AutoLanguage.label: Prefer AC3+ track
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, the receiver will select an AC3+ track (when available).

AutoLanguage.label: Prefer audio track stored by service
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, the receiver will automatically use the audio track which you selected before.

AutoLanguage.label: Subtitle language selection 1
AutoLanguage.help: Configure the first subtitle language (highest priority).

AutoLanguage.label: Allow subtitle language to equal audio language
AutoLanguage.help: Usually when the subtitle language is the same as the audio language, the subtitles will not be used. Enable this option to allow these subtitles to be used.

AutoLanguage.label: Allow subtitles for hearing impaired
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, subtitles for the hearing impaired can be used.

AutoLanguage.label: Prefer subtitles for hearing impaired
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, subtitles for the hearing impaired will be preferred over normal subtitles, when both types are available.

AutoLanguage.label: Prefer graphical DVB subtitles
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, graphical DVB subtitles are preferred over teletext subtitles, when both types are available.

AutoLanguage.label: Prefer subtitles stored by service
AutoLanguage.help: When enabled, the receiver will automatically use the subtitles which you selected before.

OSDCalibration.label: Left
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to move the OSD left.

OSDCalibration.label: Top
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to move the OSD top.

OSDCalibration.label: Right
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to move the OSD right.

OSDCalibration.label: Bottom
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to move the OSD bottom.

OSDCalibration.label: Move Left/Right
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to move the OSD left/right.

OSDCalibration.label: Move Up/Down
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to move the OSD up/down.

OSDCalibration.label: Width
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to adjust the width of the OSD. LEFT button decreases the width, RIGHT increases the width.

OSDCalibration.label: Height
OSDCalibration.help: Use the LEFT/RIGHT buttons on your remote to adjust the height of the OSD. LEFT button decreases the height, RIGHT increases the height.

OSDCalibration.label: OSD visibility
OSDCalibration.help: This option lets you adjust the transparency of the OSD.

OSDCalibration.label: Teletext base visibility
OSDCalibration.help: Base transparency for teletext, more options are available within teletext screen.

OSDCalibration.label: Web browser base visibility
OSDCalibration.help: Base transparency for OpenOpera web browser.

OSD3DCalibration.label: 3D Mode
OSD3DCalibration.help: This option lets you choose the 3D mode of the OSD.

OSD3DCalibration.label: Depth
OSD3DCalibration.help: This option lets you adjust the 3D depth of the OSD.

OSD3DCalibration.label: Show in Extension Menu
OSD3DCalibration.help: This option lets you show the 3D OSD menu option in the Extension Menu screen.

Video.help: Configures which video output connector will be used.

Video.label: Automatic resolution
Video.help: If enabled the output resolution of the receiver will try to match the resolution of the video contents resolution.

Video.label: Mode
Video.help: This option configures the video output mode (or resolution).

Video.help: Configure the aspect ratio of the screen.

Video.help: This option configures the picture sharpness.

Video.help: This option allows you to config the Colorimetry for HDR.

Video.help: This option allows you to bypass HDMI EDID check.

Video.label: HLG Support
Video.help: This option allows you to force the HLG Modes for UHD.

Video.label: HDR10 Support
Video.help: This option allows you to force the HDR10 Modes for UHD.

Video.label: Delay time
Video.help: Set the time before checking video source for resolution information.

Video.label: Automatic resolution label
Video.help: Allows you to adjust the amount of time the resolution information display on screen.

Video.label: Force de-interlace
Video.help: If enabled the video will always be de-interlaced.

Video.label: Always use smart1080p mode
Video.help: This option allows you to always use e.g. 1080p50 for TV/.ts, and 1080p24/p50/p60 for videos

Enhancement.label: Split preview mode
Enhancement.help: This option allows you to view the old and new settings side by side.

Enhancement.label: Auto flesh
Enhancement.help: This option sets the picture flesh tones.

Enhancement.label: Block noise reduction
Enhancement.help: This option allows to reduce the block-noise in the picture. Obviously this is at the cost of the picture's sharpness.

Enhancement.label: Brightness
Enhancement.help: This option sets the picture brightness.

Enhancement.label: Boost blue
Enhancement.help: This option allows you to boost the blue tones in the picture.

Enhancement.label: Boost green
Enhancement.help: This option allows you to boost the green tones in the picture.

Enhancement.label: Contrast
Enhancement.help: This option sets  the picture contrast.

Enhancement.label: Digital contour removal
Enhancement.help: This option sets the suppression of false digital contours, that are the result of a limited number of discrete values.

Enhancement.label: Dynamic contrast
Enhancement.help: This option allows to set the level of dynamic contrast of the picture.

Enhancement.label: Hue
Enhancement.help: This option sets the picture hue.

Enhancement.label: Mosquito noise reduction
Enhancement.help: This option set the level of suppression of mosquito noise (Mosquito Noise is random aliasing as a result of strong compression). Obviously this goes at the cost of picture details.

Enhancement.label: Scaler sharpness
Enhancement.help: This option sets the scaler sharpness, used when stretching picture from 4:3 to 16:9.

Enhancement.label: Scaler vertical anti-aliasing
Enhancement.help: Control the use of vertical scaler anti-aliasing.

Enhancement.label: Smooth
Enhancement.help: Control the smoothing filter used for the dithering process.

Enhancement.label: Sharpness
Enhancement.help: This option sets up the picture sharpness, used when the picture is being upscaled.

Enhancement.label: Saturation
Enhancement.help: This option sets the picture saturation.

Enhancement.label: Color space
Enhancement.help: This option sets the picture color space.
